profile.headline: Versatile Full-Stack Software Engineer with a security clearance
profile.summary:
Experienced and highly motivated full stack developer with a proven ability to innovate and excel who is proficient in multiple computer languages and development tools to consistently meet the needs of a diverse range of stakeholders

•	Languages: C#(4yr), SQL(3yr), JavaScript/TypeScript(3yr),  Kotlin(2yr), Java(2yr)
•	AWS Experience:
	• 	Automatic deployment and management of applications (CI/CD)
	• 	Security and firewall configuration and debugging
	• 	Log analysis and parsing to deep dive into new or old and undetected issues
•	SQL scripting and database interaction:
	• 	Analyzing execution plans to increase performance
	• 	Rewriting views to decrease load time
	• 	Refactored codebase from using hardcoded SQL to stored procedures
	• 	Entity Framework usage
•	Object-oriented and multi-threaded programming
•	Version Control: Git
•	Debugging complex system interactions, profiling, and optimizing efficiency 
•	Hardware: experience with building, assembling and troubleshooting computers

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained a highly scalable web service with a chain of dependencies and high availability requirements
    • Multi datacenter failover and clean retry/failure conditions
    • Auto-Scaling
• Drove operational excellence and reliability within the team:
    • Assisted with oncall policy and difficult issues encountered by the rest of the team
    • Diagnosed and resolved issues with deployed code and infrastructure
• Onboarded new technologies and features to improve reliability or functionality of the service: 
    • Advanced firewall analysis for identifying sources of API traffic
    • Test coverage information for end-to-end integration tests
• Assisted newer members of the team in familiarizing themselves with systems and processes
• Worked successfully with a distributed team of remote workers from coast to coast
• Worked hybrid and fully remote, and worked independently to deliver projects
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Kotlin · JavaScript · TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Web Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed .Net framework based microservices, with a mix of logic, database interaction, and messaging
• Created quick and functional data retrieval services with dependency injection and inter-service communication

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Functioned independently to support CWRU School of Medicine’s existing legacy websites while the team focused on developing newer projects
• Developed new skills that were missing amongst the team and then utilized them to improve the site design
• Met with faculty to gather requirements for new features, evaluate plans and technologies for implementation, update status, and deliver high quality products on time
• Positively contributed to cross-functional teams that work across campus to support university-wide website development
• Mentored junior programmers, helping them learn the different frameworks and systems being used

company.name: Case Western Reserve University School of Medicine

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Specialized in .Net and SQL development, and utilized other languages as applicable to address the needs of the position, including Visual Studio 2015 and 2017, VB.net, C#, JavaScript, ASP and CSS
• Worked on back-end logic, database interaction, and individual apps to automate processes
SQL scripting and database interaction:
• Analyzed execution plans to increase performance
• Rewrote views to decrease load time
• Refactored codebase from using hardcoded SQL to stored procedures
